estimates.assumptions: 5 boneless, skinless chicken breasts; each estimated at ~8 oz (227g) raw edible portion based on common large breast size in recipes, total 2.5 lb.
1 medium butternut squash (or similar) cut into 1/2-inch cubes; whole edible flesh ~196g after peeling/seeding, typical for a ~1 lb raw squash.
1 medium head of broccoli, chopped; typical edible chopped weight ~608g (including some stem).
8-ounce package of sliced mushrooms; used supplied package weight directly as edible mass.
1 medium red bell pepper; typical edible weight ~119g after coring.
1/2 cup white wine; standard volume-to-mass conversion ~119g.
Pinch of salt; modest estimate of ~1g for a small pinch, negligible mass.
Pinch of pepper; modest estimate of ~1g for a small pinch.
Chopped parsley for garnish; modest estimate of ~5g (a small handful) as 'to taste' garnish.
